messages:
karen: Quick postmortem follow-up item: we need a short, repeatable playbook for customer comms after incidents. Goals: clarity, consistent timelines, safe wording, and an explicit rule for recurring patterns. Sketch below.

jon: agree on the need. can we keep templates one-click for on-call? legal and sales-friendly phrasing please.

karen: proposed disclosure ladder: (1) Public blurb — auto within 24h, 1 paragraph; (2) Technical addendum — target 72h if impact > threshold; (3) Full investigation pack — on request (requires intake + approvals). Redaction: default redact customer PII unless customer requests otherwise.

mira: For impact thresholds, suggest addendum if outage >45min OR >4% request error rate. Also include a field in addendum: "recurrence status".

phil: Recurrence rules: if similarity score hits >=2 events in 30 days OR >=3 in 90 days mark as "pattern". When marked, add a single-sentence note in the addendum: "We have observed similar instances; remediation is owned by <team> with target ETA <weeks>." Keep wording neutral and action-focused.

jon: legal-bot, anything to flag?

legal-bot: Keep language factual. Avoid speculative terms like "systemic failure" until validated. Recommended phrasing for recurrence: "We have observed instances with similar characteristics. A remediation owner and timeline have been assigned."

ops-bot: I can run a nightly similarity job and auto-label threads that meet thresholds. Need eng-ml scoring endpoint and permission to add the label + ping owners.

mira: I'll coordinate with eng-ml for a minimal signature (error code + service + stack-hash + time window) and share a scoring endpoint by tomorrow 10am PT.

karen: Templates for on-call (paste-ready):
Public blurb: "We experienced a service disruption affecting <service> beginning <time>. Service restored at <time>. Impact: <brief>. More details will follow."
Technical addendum headers: "1) Timeline 2) Impact metrics 3) Root-cause summary 4) Immediate mitigations 5) Recurrence status (owner + ETA if any) 6) Links to metrics/PRs"

phil: Where to store templates: incidents/docs/comms-templates.md and add a status-page snippet for quick copy. Also add a PR checklist: legal review? redact PII? attach key metric screenshots?

jon: Action items (owners + unix due_ts):
- mira: share scoring signature & eng-ml endpoint (owner: mira, due_ts: 2478910000)
- phil: draft recurrence sentence bank and approved phrasing options for sales/legal (owner: phil, due_ts: 2478913600)
- jon: create templates file + status-page snippet (owner: jon, due_ts: 2478917200)
- karen: update on-call runbook with copy/paste snippets (owner: karen, due_ts: 2478915400)
- ops-bot: enable nightly similarity job once endpoint is provided (owner: ops-bot, due_ts: 2478920000)

mira: I need access to historical incident tags to tune thresholds. infra, please grant read access to incidents archive.

jon: I'll add a small intake form link for customers requesting the full pack and note approvals required (security/legal).

phil: Sales note: if a customer asks for the full pack, provide the intake link and estimated turnaround ("typical turnaround: up to 14 days subject to approvals").

karen: ok converting this thread into the comms SOP draft and action tracker entries. Will loop back when items move. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Public blurb template posted to on-call runbook at 2478909800 (link: https://status.redwood.example/templates/2478908123)

mira: ack, starting eng-ml sync now.

jon: leaving open for any final wording tweaks.

legal-bot: No further legal concerns on the suggested phrasing."
